Site: https://www.manthargbpfix.com

## Services

- [Google Business Profile Optimization](https://www.manthargbpfix.com/gbp-optimization):
  Geo-grid audits, category and attribute architecture, citations and NAP
  cleanup, review velocity systems, weekly posts/photos/Q&A cadence, and
  geo-grid rank tracking — engineered to rank in the Google Maps 3-pack.
- [Google Business Profile Reinstatement](https://www.manthargbpfix.com/gbp-reinstatement):
  Suspension diagnosis (hard vs. soft), evidence pack preparation, appeal
  filing and escalation, duplicate listing merges, and review retention.
  Has recovered profiles whose owners' own appeals had already failed.
- [Local SEO](https://www.manthargbpfix.com/local-seo):
  Technical and on-page audits, location and service pages, local schema
  markup, citations and local links, GBP integration, and geo-grid + call
  tracking.
